### ST-070

**Setup recommendation engine**

*As a **developer**, I want **a recommended setup plan with a reason for every choice**, so that **I understand and trust what init proposes**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S7 | B09, §5.5 | [ST-021](DET-project-detection.md#st-021), [ST-022](DET-project-detection.md#st-022), [ST-023](DET-project-detection.md#st-023), [ST-024](DET-project-detection.md#st-024), [ST-025](DET-project-detection.md#st-025), [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Plan covers layout, naming, adapters, coverage provider, include/exclude, impact mode, snapshots, store dir, workers and suggested rules
- [x] Every recommendation has a reason and evidence
- [x] Warnings list untested modules and global-impact config files

---

### ST-071

**`smarttest init` wizard and setup modes**

*As a **developer**, I want **interactive, automatic, advanced and non-interactive init**, so that **setup fits my context, including CI**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 8 | S7 | B10, §5.2, §5.6 | [ST-070](INI-smart-init.md#st-070), [ST-015](CLI-cli-developer-experience.md#st-015) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Interactive mode shows the plan and lets me accept/edit each section
- [x] `--auto` applies only low-risk actions; `--advanced` exposes all options
- [x] `--yes --non-interactive` never prompts; missing required input exits 3 deterministically

---

### ST-072

**Init dry-run and change preview**

*As a **cautious developer**, I want **to see every file init would create or modify**, so that **nothing surprises me**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S7 | B11, §5.7 | [ST-070](INI-smart-init.md#st-070) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `init --dry-run` prints a diff of every change and writes nothing (verified by FS snapshot)
- [x] Preview distinguishes create / modify / skip-existing
- [x] Same plan is produced by dry-run and real run

### ST-073

**Safe configuration writing**

*As a **developer**, I want **init to merge into my existing files safely**, so that **my configuration and scripts are preserved**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S7 | B12, §5.7 | [ST-072](INI-smart-init.md#st-072) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Atomic writes (temp + rename); package.json scripts merged without duplicates or reformatting unrelated keys
- [x] Name collisions detected; existing files never replaced without explicit approval
- [x] `.smarttest/` added to .gitignore; no dependency major upgrades; no install hooks executed

---

### ST-074

**Setup validation and setup report**

*As a **developer**, I want **init to verify the setup works and summarise what it did**, so that **I know I'm ready to run**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S7 | B13, §5.4 | [ST-073](INI-smart-init.md#st-073), [ST-049](EXE-test-execution.md#st-049), [ST-050](EXE-test-execution.md#st-050) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Validates config schema and that the chosen adapter discovers tests
- [x] Writes `.smarttest/reports/setup.md` with actions, warnings and next steps
- [x] Unsupported setups produce actionable diagnostics instead of partial installs

### ST-075

**Idempotent init**

*As a **developer**, I want **re-running init to be harmless**, so that **I can safely re-run it after upgrades**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S8 | B14, §5.8 | [ST-073](INI-smart-init.md#st-073) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Second run on an initialised fixture produces zero changes
- [x] User edits to generated config are preserved
- [x] Covered by a test across all 8 fixtures

---

### ST-076

**Init rollback**

*As a **developer**, I want **to undo what init changed**, so that **trying SmartTest is risk-free**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S8 | B15, §5.7 | [ST-073](INI-smart-init.md#st-073) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Init records a change journal in `.smarttest/state/init-journal.json`
- [x] `init --rollback` restores modified files and removes created ones (if unmodified since)
- [x] Files edited after init are reported, not overwritten

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S8 | §6.4, §26.2 | [ST-074](INI-smart-init.md#st-074) |
